title: Waymo paid robotaxi rides per week

source.name: Waymo ride volume announcements
source.publisher: Waymo, as reported by TechCrunch and The Verge

notes: Waymo said it was providing about 10,000 paid trips a week in October 2023, more than 100,000 a week in August 2024, and about 200,000 a week in February 2025 -- roughly 20x growth in about 16 months, per Waymo's own announcements as reported by TechCrunch and The Verge.
